name: N-desethylprotonitazene
summary: N-Desethylprotonitazene is a benzimidazole opioid with potent analgesic effects which has been sold as a designer drug. It was first identified in 2024 as an active metabolite of the closely related compound protonitazene, and was found to have less potency than it while still being more potent than fentanyl.
